provenance.sourceName: TAK Ferrite product catalog 2024 (PDF metadata title 'TAK2024 FINAL')
provenance.verificationMethod: page 14, section 'Physical Parameters 物理参数' (table is an embedded image; read visually). Source scope: TAK 'ferrite components' in general (catalog 'Physical Parameters' table, stated as order-of-magnitude values, not grade-specific). As printed: Thermal Conductivity: 4 x 10^-3 J/mm sec °C  (= 4e-3 J/(mm*s*K) = 4 W/(m*K)); no specific heat stated. Note: Vendor explicitly calls these order-of-magnitude values for ferrite components in general (no MnZn/NiZn split). Same table also gives linear expansion 10x10-6/°C, Young's modulus 1.5x10^5 N/mm2, density 4-5 g/cm3. Table text is an image (pdftotext does not extract it); verified by rendering at 300 dpi. TAK per-grade sheets (DL5, DL5H PDFs) contain no thermal values. If an order-of-magnitude general value is judged too weak for grade records, treat as NOT FOUND.
